Research Program

Research

My research vision is to build adaptive and trustworthy intelligence at the edge, where machine learning systems can operate securely, efficiently, and reliably in cyber-physical environments.

Current Interests

TinyML

Efficient intelligence for low-power embedded platforms.

Edge AI

Practical machine learning systems running at the network edge.

Runtime AI Adaptation

Methods for dynamic model updates under changing operating conditions.

Federated Learning

Privacy-preserving collaborative model training across distributed nodes.

AI Security

Robustness and adversarial defense for deployed machine learning systems.

Embedded Intelligence

Tight integration of sensing, compute, and decision logic.

Cyber Physical Systems

Reliable AI-enabled systems that interact with physical environments.

Current Projects

Adaptive TinyML Runtime Policies

Investigating strategies that balance performance, memory, and power in dynamic edge workloads.

Ongoing experimentation and benchmark design.

Edge Vision for Traffic and Mobility

Building robust vision pipelines for tracking, analytics, and anomaly detection in constrained hardware settings.

Active development and validation.

Secure AI Inference for Embedded Platforms

Studying threat models and defense strategies for embedded AI deployment.

Dataset preparation and attack simulation.

Research Roadmap

2026 Q3

Baseline Models and Experimental Infrastructure

Reproducible benchmark suite and deployment-ready baselines.

2026 Q4

Adaptation and Security Experiments

Comparative evaluation of adaptation and robustness strategies.

2027 Q1

Publication and Open Source Release

Manuscript submission and release of reusable research artifacts.

Future Directions

Federated Embedded Intelligence

Combine federated learning with low-power deployment constraints.

Formal Reliability Analysis for Edge AI

Integrate verification thinking into AI-enabled embedded systems.

AI for Safety-Critical CPS

Expand into transport, agriculture, and infrastructure safety use-cases.
